v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Commune aut Festo

text.la: Dum esset Rex * in accúbitu suo, nardus mea dedit odórem suavitátis, allelúia.
text.en: While the King sitteth at his table, * my spikenard sendeth forth the smell thereof, alleluia.

text.la: Læva eius * sub cápite meo, et déxtera illíus amplexábitur me, allelúia.
text.en: His left hand is under my head, * and his right hand doth embrace me, alleluia.

text.la: Nigra sum, * sed formósa, fíliæ Ierúsalem; ídeo diléxit me Rex, et introdúxit me in cubículum suum, allelúia.
text.en: I am black but comely, * O ye daughters of Jerusalem; therefore hath the King loved me, and brought me into his chamber, alleluia.

text.la: Iam hiems tránsiit, * imber ábiit et recéssit: surge, amíca mea, et veni, allelúia.
text.en: Lo the winter is past, * the rain is over and gone. Rise up, my love, and come away, alleluia.

text.la: Speciósa * facta es et suávis in delíciis tuis, sancta Dei Génetrix, allelúia.
text.en: O Holy Mother of God, thou art become beautiful * and gentle in thy gladness, alleluia.

text.la: Regína mundi digníssima, * María, Virgo perpétua, intercéde pro nostra pace et salúte, quæ genuísti Christum Dóminum, Salvatórem ómnium. Allelúia.
text.en: O worthy Queen of the world, * Mary ever-Virgin, intercede for our peace and salvation, thou who gave birth to Christ the Lord, the Saviour of all. Alleluia.

text.la: Concéde nobis, quǽsumus, Dómine: ut, qui solemnitátem beatæ Maríæ Vírginis Regínæ nostræ celebrámus; eius muníti præsídio, pacem in præsénti et glóriam in futúro cónsequi mereámur.
text.en: Grant, O Lord, we beseech Thee, to those who are celebrating this solemnity of the Blessed Virgin Mary our Queen: that safe in her protection we may deserve to enjoy present peace and future glory.

text.la: Símile est regnum cælórum hómini negotiatóri quærénti bonas margarítas: invénta una pretiósa, dedit ómnia sua, et comparávit eam, allelúia.
text.en: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchantman seeking goodly pearls, who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it, alleluia.

v.la: Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis, allelúia.
v.en: Grace is poured into thy lips, alleluia.

r.la: Proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum, allelúia.
r.en: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever, alleluia.

text.la: Exáudi nos, Deus, salutáris noster: ut sicut de beátæ Petroníllæ Vírginis tuæ festivitáte gaudémus; ita piæ devotiónis erudiámur afféctu.
text.en: Graciously hear us, O God of our salvation; that as we rejoice in the festivity of blessed Petronilla thy Virgin, we may be instructed in the affections of a loving devotion.
